heading: What we collect
body: Wasteful stores your addresses and bin collection schedules locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or store this information on any server.

heading: Find My Council
body: When you use Find My Council, tapping a result opens that council's own website in your browser. We don't track which council you search for or visit.

heading: Notifications
body: Reminder notifications are scheduled entirely on your device using the times and preferences you set. No notification data leaves your phone.

heading: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes, the update date below will reflect the most recent revision.
